name: Epicatechin
short: In the cited sources, data on epicatechin alone are limited to very small, short studies: purified (-)-epicatechin for up to 5 days in 17 healthy volunteers had no observed adverse effects.
text: In a phase I open-label study, 17 healthy volunteers took purified (-)-epicatechin as a single dose or daily for 5 days; it was well tolerated with no observed adverse effects. A pilot study of the related stereoisomer (+)-epicatechin, given as single oral doses and then daily for 7 days to healthy and pre-diabetic people, reported that it was well tolerated with no adverse effects. In a randomised, double-blind, placebo-controlled trial in 21,442 older US adults, a cocoa extract supplement (a mixture of cocoa flavanols that included 80 mg of (-)-epicatechin daily, not epicatechin alone) raised no safety concerns over a median follow-up of 3.6 years. Longer-term safety data for epicatechin on its own were not found in the cited sources. No interaction data were found in the cited sources.
